```yaml
name: Test Meshery Integration

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
    paths-ignore:
      - 'system/**'
      - '*.md'

jobs:
  test-meshery-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v3

    - name: Set up Node.js 20
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '20'
        cache: 'npm'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Build Sistent
      run: npm run build

    - name: Package Sistent
      run: npm pack

    - name: Download Meshery UI repository
      run: git clone https://github.com/meshery/meshery.git

    - name: Move Sistent package to Meshery UI directory
      run: mv sistent-x.x.x.tgz meshery/ui/

    - name: Change directory to Meshery UI
      working-directory: meshery/ui/
      run: cd ui

    - name: Install Meshery UI dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Run Meshery UI build
      run: npm run build

    - name: Check for test script
      id: check_test_script
      run: |
        if grep -E '"test"\s*:' package.json; then
          echo "::set-output name=test_script_found::true"
        else
          echo "::set-output name=test_script_found::false"
        fi

    - name: Run Meshery UI tests
      if: ${{ steps.check_test_script.outputs.test_script_found == 'true' }}
      run: npm test

    - name: Report test results
      if: ${{ failure() }}
      run: echo "Integration tests failed. Please review the logs."
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

    - name: Report test results
      if: ${{ success() }}
      run: echo "Integration tests passed. Sistent is compatible with Meshery UI."
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
